_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 78% bottom analog and sentiment exhaustion at Fear & Greed 28 favor a transition from Denial into early Disbelief recovery, but the coil base rate (5% directional windows) means this is a slow grind not a breakout.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst forward call is HOLD (citing coil base rate and his own poor directional accuracy), narrative implies UP via mean-reversion framing; consensus judge breaks the split toward UP given the structural analog strength.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks above $62k with funding turning positive and fear_greed lifting above 35, confirming the transition from Denial into Disbelief recovery
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding spikes negative (<-0.01%) with fear_greed dropping below 20 and stablecoin_growth accelerating above 55, signaling a flush lower that would drop the phase back toward Panic
